rel_notes.n:
This split gives Multigres the context to do more than basic connection reuse. In v0.1.0, that includes per-user pools, fair-share allocation, primary routing, replica reads, multi-cell pooler discovery, failover buffering, prepared statement handling, transaction awareness, COPY support, LISTEN/NOTIFY, query cancellation, and session pinning when PostgreSQL state requires it.
v0.1.0 includes SCRAM-SHA-256 authentication, TLS for PostgreSQL client connections, mTLS for internal gRPC, password-file support,
